MediaPipe Face Landmarker files, served next to the page because the app fetches them at runtime.

- `vision_wasm_internal.wasm` from npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14` (Apache-2.0)
- `face_landmarker.task` (float16, v1) from Google's MediaPipe model storage (Apache-2.0)

The JavaScript bundle and the WASM loader are loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net at the same version.
